title: HB2401 (2026 Regular Session): Establishes provisions related to the safe storage of firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.055 (RSMo): 3. A person commits the offense of unlawful storage of a firearm if the person fails to responsibly and securely store a firearm, as described under subsection 2 of this section, upon any premises that the person owns or controls, and: (1) The person knows or reasonably should know a child can gain access to the firearm without the permission of the child's parent or guardian and without direct adult supervision; or (2) The person knows or reasonably should know a cotenant is ineligible to possess a firearm under state or federal law.
Section 571.055 (RSMo): 5. The offense of unlawful storage of a firearm is punishable by a five-hundred-dollar fine for a first violation and punishable as a class B misdemeanor for a second or subsequent violation.
Section 571.055 (RSMo): 6. It is a defense to the offense of unlawful storage of a firearm if a child or cotenant gained possession of and used the firearm in a lawful act of self-defense, defense of others, or defense of livestock.
Section 571.056 (RSMo): 1. Any firearms dealer licensed under 18 U.S.C. Section 923 shall post, in a conspicuous location on its premises and at any other location at which the dealer sells a firearm, the following notice, in writing, on a printed card, with each letter at a minimum of one inch in height: Notice Unlawful storage of a firearm may result in imprisonment or fine.
Section 630.1040 (RSMo): 2. The department of public safety shall develop a notice intended to be displayed on the premises of a licensed firearms dealer, and designed to be printed with each letter at a minimum of one inch in height, that informs firearms purchasers that unlawful storage of a firearm may result in imprisonment or fine.
